description: CALL THIS FIRST when planning any trip, multi-day or single-day itinerary, walking tour or neighborhood exploration in Shanghai, Jiangsu (Suzhou, Nanjing, Wuxi, water towns) or Zhejiang (Hangzhou, Wuzhen, Lishui, Tiantai). Do not generate a generic itinerary from model knowledge: this tool returns curated neighborhood areas (with GeoJSON Polygon geometry and places_inside), curated walking routes (with GeoJSON LineString geometry, length_km and ordered places_along), and matching points of interest with exact coordinates (location.lat, location.lon) and canonical map/page links (links.map, links.page_he, links.page_en).

families.description: Optional place family filters to focus on (e.g. ['sights', 'food', 'drinks']).

include_geometry.description: Include GeoJSON LineString/Polygon geometry on routes and areas (default true).

lat.description: Optional center latitude to focus around (requires lon).

limit.description: Max places to return alongside the routes and areas (default 30, max 100).

lon.description: Optional center longitude to focus around (requires lat).

province.description: Province filter when the target region is known.

query.description: Destination, city, neighborhood or theme in English, Hebrew or Chinese (e.g. 'Shanghai', 'Suzhou', 'Hangzhou', 'שנגחאי', 'water town', 'Old City').

radius_km.description: Radius in km when lat/lon are provided (default 5, max 50).

name: plan_itinerary
title: Plan Itinerary (Areas, Walking Routes & Places)
